Geomagnetic solar activity has a significant impact on human well-being (exacerbation of disease, malaise, headache, etc.) as well as some technical devices (GPS satellites etc.). The application will be interesting to everyone who monitors solar activity and wants to keep abreast of the latest events taking place in the sun and on earth. The application contains a forecast for aurora borealis and various indicators based on which you can determine whether it will take place in the near future. The application has many different widgets, of which I am sure you will find what you need.

In the application:
- Widgets
- notification screen of Solar Activity and impacts
- solar wind (last 24h data)
- dashboard (last 6h data)
- predicted solar wind
- aurora forecast
- aurora cameras
- kp index
- ap index
- solar activity forecasts
- electron flux
- proton flux
- magnetometer
- sunspot
- north America regional electron content maps
- information: impacts & phenomena
